lane:
تلمذ

تَلْمَذَ _He was,_ or _became, a_ تِلْمِيذ [or _disciple,_ &c.], لِفُلَانٍ _to such a one._ (TA, passim.)

تلميذ تِلْمِيذٌ _A disciple; a pupil; a learner:_ or _a special servant of a teacher:_ so says 'Abd-El- Kádir El-Baghdádee, who composed a treatise solely on this word: (MF, TA:) or simply _a servant; a follower; a dependant:_ pl. تَلَامِيذُ (L, TA) [and تَلَامِذَةٌ].

entries.text: تلمذ: التلاميذُ: الخَدَمُ والأَتباع، واحدهم تِلْميذٌ.
